$description: AvatarGroup (platform/components/AvatarGroup, library wave 4, lane B): its component tokens. The avatars themselves use Avatar's tokens.

avatar-group-ring.$description: AvatarGroup stack: the ring around each avatar, in the surface color, that keeps overlapped edges apart.

avatar-group-focus-ring.$description: AvatarGroup: the +N tile's ring while its button has keyboard focus (the focus color).

avatar-group-xs-overlap.$description: AvatarGroup stack, size xs: how far each avatar overlaps the one before it (4px).

avatar-group-sm-overlap.$description: AvatarGroup stack, size sm: how far each avatar overlaps the one before it (4px).

avatar-group-md-overlap.$description: AvatarGroup stack, size md: how far each avatar overlaps the one before it (8px).

avatar-group-lg-overlap.$description: AvatarGroup stack, size lg: how far each avatar overlaps the one before it (8px).

avatar-group-gap.$description: AvatarGroup grid: the gap between avatars, across and down.

avatar-group-more-background-hover.$description: AvatarGroup: the +N tile's fill while its button is hovered.

avatar-group-more-font-family.$description: AvatarGroup: the +N count's face (the data font: a number).
